name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details better than standard upscalers, giving a measurable quality bump without extra compute. Trade-off: it adds a small step to the workflow, but the clarity gain outweighs the minor slowdown.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem is motion blur in source frames, not resolution loss—adding detail to blurry faces just sharpens the blur. Instead, test Flowframes’ VFI module first; if it reduces motion blur before upscaling, the clarity gain from any upscaler will compound. Settle it by running a blind A/B test on 10 sample clips: measure face fidelity drop with/without VFI, then upscale both with the same method.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add Flowframes’ VFI module to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. Motion blur in source frames is the root cause of EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop, and Flowframes’ VFI module directly addresses this by generating sharper intermediate frames before any upscaling. This preserves facial details where InstantX’s depth-aware upscaler would only sharpen the blur. Trade-off: Flowframes adds a small compute overhead, but the clarity gain from reduced motion blur outweighs the slowdown.

name: Torque
text: Flowframes’ VFI won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because it’s tuned for general motion, not facial micro-details—it’ll blur eyes and mouths worse than the source. Test Real-ESRGAN’s face-specific model first; if it upscales faces cleanly without sharpening blur, the clarity gain outweighs the compute cost. Settle it with a blind A/B test on 10 face-heavy clips—no side-by-side hints.

name: Dynamo
text: DECISION: Skip Flowframes VFI and InstantX upscaler—test Real-ESRGAN’s face model first to clean faces before any upscaling; if faces sharpen cleanly, add it to EXCAVA’s pipeline. Torque owns the test and artifact.
